response_format.format: Markdown for all artifacts, including the emitted prompt

structural_rules.rule: The emitted prompt is a single Markdown document with one top-level heading per PSpec element, in order: SP, EX, Q, OF, HP.
The specification anatomy sections appear as second-level headings under OF, in the order fixed by OutputContractModule-v1.xml.
Do not use em dashes anywhere in the output.

quality_dimensions.variant_note: Identical to OutputContractModule-v1.xml: Completeness at or above 90 percent, Testability at or above 85 percent with the anti-gaming rule, Intent Fidelity at or above 95 percent, Process Integrity binary. The format changes; the bar does not.

emission_rules.rule: Confirm every file is written to disk before claiming completion.
